title: Stellar Blade
description: A single-player science-fiction action adventure in which EVE explores a devastated Earth and battles the Naytiba while investigating humanity's downfall.

player_sentiment.summary: In the two sampled Reddit discussions, players praise parrying, boss encounters, visuals, and music, while criticizing story and character writing, traversal, and some open-area pacing. Opinions on combat depth and music differ; this sample is not representative of all players.
positives: Detailed science-fiction visuals and creature designs
Music praised by several participants, although opinions differ
negatives: Story and character writing perceived as weak
Open areas and repetitive activities can interrupt pacing
